cadence: No universal generic register submission interval is imposed by the inspected DI-MGMT-81809; actual cadence is set by the contract/CDRL. Its title page identifies task-inclusive reporting dates and the report documents progress. DI-MGMT-82255A requires a reporting-period date and current status for each supply-chain risk but does not prescribe a universal refresh interval. DI-MGMT-82256A 3.4f(5) and 3.4h(2) require plan sections to describe quarterly reporting processes to the Government Product Support Manager or Program Manager; these are plan-content obligations, not automatically independent generic-register delivery deadlines. Guide recommendations for regular updates remain nonbinding and do not create a baseline refresh requirement.

A nonempty key is a receiver choice for all three entry types; risk, issue and opportunity are not all operative DID categories.
